paragraphs.text: Universia Beyondia is a non-canon plane subtype featured on a playtest card at the 2024 Amsterdam Planechase Unknown event.

Universia Beyondia originally debuted on Multiversal High Council at the 2024 Amsterdam Planechase Unknown event and was later re-printed at the 2024 Las Vegas Planechase Unknown event. It appears to be a plane that encompasses all IP universes ; the entire set of Universes Beyond universes and the Magic: The Gathering universe.

The Multiversal High Council make it so Universe Beyond spells cost less mana and increase the power and toughness of creatures based on how many different universes the player has on the battlefield. When chaos ensues , for each different universe they control they may return a card from that universe from the graveyard to the player's hand.
